name: Thelgen Rock
summary: In the southern mountain wall of the Wetlands, Thelgen Rock’s caverns hold volatile Incendicite Ore. Venomous spiders infest the passages.

sections.title: A Web-Choked Cavern
sections.body: Thelgen Rock cuts deep into the mountains between the Wetlands and Loch Modan. Aggressive spiders fill its web-choked passages, and their venom makes every step dangerous. Miners and adventurers still brave the tunnels for the valuable Incendicite Ore embedded in the rock.

faq.answer: Large, poisonous spiders crowd Thelgen Rock’s caverns. Their webs fill the winding tunnels, where travelers can be cornered and overwhelmed by venomous bites.

faq.q: Why do prospectors and miners come here?
faq.answer: The caves hold rich seams of fiery, volatile Incendicite Ore, sought by dwarven prospectors and engineers. Despite the spiders, miners enter to gather samples from the cave walls.
Thelgen Rock lies along the Wetlands’ southern mountain ridge, south of the main road between Menethil Harbor and the Dun Algaz mountain pass.

angles.text: Rare Incendicite Ore deposits lie deep within Thelgen Rock, drawing prospectors beneath the mountain despite the danger.
